title: Evaluation dataset
description: Schema for the curated assessment question set (FR-039). The file is committed to version control; this schema makes it machine-validated and structurally prevents the exact-URL pinning that FR-063 forbids. There is deliberately no URL field anywhere, and every object is closed, so a pinned source cannot be introduced through a new property either. Grading is by topic coverage (FR-064).

dataset_version.description: Identity of this dataset. An evaluation run records the version and a content fingerprint, so two runs are never silently compared across different datasets.

generated_at.description: Editorial timestamp. Not a run timestamp; runs carry their own.

notes.description: Editorial notes about the set as a whole — coverage, known gaps, deliberate exclusions.

questions.description: FR-039 requires at least 30 questions spanning eight categories and three difficulties.

id.description: Stable identifier, referenced by per-question evaluation results. Changing it orphans historical results.

question.description: The question text, within the same bound the API enforces (FR-043).

category.description: FR-039 requires coverage of all eight. 'unsupported' questions are the deliberately-unanswerable set behind SC-008.

is_unsupported.description: True for questions the corpus genuinely does not cover. These must be refused with zero fabricated facts and zero fabricated citations (SC-008). Retrieval metrics are null for them — not applicable, not zero.

tags.description: Optional editorial labels for slicing a run's results.

allOf.description: The 'unsupported' category and the is_unsupported flag must agree, so a deliberately-unanswerable question cannot be silently filed as a normal one.

expectation.description: What a correct response must cover, expressed as topics rather than a canonical answer string (FR-040). Multiple valid answers are accepted; notes may record alternative valid phrasings so a correct answer in unexpected words is not scored as a failure.

must_refuse.description: True when a refusal is the only acceptable outcome. For supported questions this is false, and an unwarranted refusal counts against the run.

product.description: Expected product domain, as a topic expectation. Null when the question genuinely spans products or no single product applies.

category.description: Expected documentation category, as a topic expectation.

heading_path.description: Expected heading path or paths. Topic-graded, not pinned to a URL, so a publisher reorganising their documentation does not produce a false regression (FR-063, FR-064). May be empty when heading-level grading is not meaningful for the question.

topics.description: Substantive points a correct answer must cover. Claim coverage is scored against these (SC-006), so each entry should be one checkable assertion rather than a topic label.

notes.description: Guidance for a human grader and for model-based scoring. Record alternative valid answers here rather than widening 'topics', so coverage stays measurable.

acceptable_alternatives.description: Alternative correct answers or phrasings. Present so a valid answer in unexpected words is not scored as a failure (FR-040).
